docs.title: Standards
docs.description: Documentation for shared Terra Symposium packages and tools.

scripts.build: cd .. && pnpm --filter @terra-symposium/standards-quality build && pnpm --filter @terra-symposium/standards-error-boundaries build && node packages/quality/dist/lib/runner.js error-boundaries --all && pnpm -r build
scripts.test: cd .. && pnpm --filter './packages/**' -r build && node packages/testing/src/cli.mjs run --manifest config/terra-tests.json
scripts.quality: cd .. && pnpm --filter @terra-symposium/standards-quality build && node scripts/quality.mjs quality --skip-commands --skip-recommendations
